fr.translation: Référence de station publique des US

fr.english: Load its latest published observations. These are separate from monthly climate averages; they do not change the crop planner or approve local growing guidance.
fr.translation: Charger ses dernières observations publiées. Celles-ci sont distinctes des moyennes climatiques mensuelles ; elles ne modifient pas le planificateur de cultures ni n'approuvent les conseils locaux de culture.
Chargement des observations de la station…
Charger les observations de la station publique

fr.english: Sign in to load this public station reference.
fr.translation: Connectez-vous pour charger cette référence de station publique.

fr.english: This request was rate-limited. Try later; no automatic retry is made.
fr.translation: Cette requête a été limitée en débit. Réessayez plus tard ; aucune nouvelle tentative automatique n'est effectuée.

fr.english: The station reference could not be loaded. No replacement readings were supplied.
fr.translation: La référence de station n'a pas pu être chargée. Aucun relevé de remplacement n'a été fourni.

fr.english: Loading the station reference timed out. No replacement readings were supplied.
fr.translation: Le chargement de la référence de station a expiré. Aucun relevé de remplacement n'a été fourni.

fr.english: The provider supplied no usable station reference. No replacement readings were supplied.
fr.translation: Le fournisseur n'a fourni aucune référence de station utilisable. Aucun relevé de remplacement n'a été fourni.

fr.english: Freshness has not been assessed. A successful request does not establish current conditions on your farm.
fr.translation: La fraîcheur n'a pas été évaluée. Une requête réussie n'établit pas les conditions actuelles sur votre exploitation.

fr.english: The published observation time is after the retrieval time. Check the source before relying on it.
fr.translation: L'heure d'observation publiée est postérieure à l'heure de récupération. Vérifiez la source avant de vous y fier.

fr.english: Missing, invalid or unsupported measurements remain unknown. Zero is shown only when the source supplies zero.
fr.translation: Les mesures manquantes, invalides ou non prises en charge restent inconnues. Zéro n'est affiché que lorsque la source fournit zéro.

fr.english: Source QC flags are retained without treating them as independent field verification.
fr.translation: Les indicateurs de QC de la source sont conservés sans les traiter comme une vérification de terrain indépendante.

es.translation: No se pudo cargar la referencia de la estación. No se proporcionaron lecturas de reemplazo.

es.english: Loading the station reference timed out. No replacement readings were supplied.
es.translation: Se agotó el tiempo de espera al cargar la referencia de la estación. No se proporcionaron lecturas de reemplazo.

es.english: The provider supplied no usable station reference. No replacement readings were supplied.
es.translation: El proveedor no facilitó ninguna referencia de estación utilizable. No se proporcionaron lecturas de reemplazo.

es.english: Freshness has not been assessed. A successful request does not establish current conditions on your farm.
es.translation: La actualidad no ha sido evaluada. Una solicitud exitosa no establece las condiciones actuales en su granja.

es.english: The published observation time is after the retrieval time. Check the source before relying on it.
es.translation: La hora de observación publicada es posterior a la hora de recuperación. Verifique la fuente antes de confiar en ella.

es.english: Missing, invalid or unsupported measurements remain unknown. Zero is shown only when the source supplies zero.
es.translation: Las mediciones faltantes, no válidas o no compatibles permanecen desconocidas. Se muestra cero únicamente cuando la fuente proporciona cero.

es.english: Source QC flags are retained without treating them as independent field verification.
es.translation: Los indicadores de QC de la fuente se conservan sin tratarlos como verificación de campo independiente.

sw.translation: Rejea ya kituo cha umma cha US
Tazama kituo cha umma cha hali ya hewa

sw.english: Load its latest published observations. These are separate from monthly climate averages; they do not change the crop planner or approve local growing guidance.
sw.translation: Pakia vipimo vyake vya hivi karibuni vilivyochapishwa. Hivi ni tofauti na wastani wa hali ya hewa wa kila mwezi; havibadilishi mpangaji wa mazao wala kuidhinisha mwongozo wa kilimo wa eneo husika.
Pakia vipimo vya kituo cha umma

sw.english: Sign in to load this public station reference.
sw.translation: Ingia ili kupakia rejea hii ya kituo cha umma.

sw.english: This request was rate-limited. Try later; no automatic retry is made.
sw.translation: Ombi hili limewekewa kikomo cha mara ngapi linaweza kutumwa. Jaribu tena baadaye; hakuna jaribio la kiotomatiki litakalofanywa.

sw.english: The station reference could not be loaded. No replacement readings were supplied.
sw.translation: Rejea ya kituo haikuweza kupakiwa. Hakuna vipimo mbadala vilivyotolewa.

sw.english: Loading the station reference timed out. No replacement readings were supplied.
sw.translation: Muda wa kupakia rejea ya kituo umekwisha. Hakuna vipimo mbadala vilivyotolewa.

sw.english: The provider supplied no usable station reference. No replacement readings were supplied.
sw.translation: Mtoa huduma hakutoa rejea ya kituo inayoweza kutumika. Hakuna vipimo mbadala vilivyotolewa.

sw.english: Freshness has not been assessed. A successful request does not establish current conditions on your farm.
sw.translation: Usasisho haujatathminiwa. Ombi lililofanikiwa halithibitishi hali halisi ya sasa kwenye shamba lako.

sw.english: The published observation time is after the retrieval time. Check the source before relying on it.
sw.translation: Wakati wa kipimo uliotangazwa ni baada ya wakati wa kupakua. Kagua chanzo kabla ya kukiamini.

sw.english: Missing, invalid or unsupported measurements remain unknown. Zero is shown only when the source supplies zero.
sw.translation: Vipimo vinavyokosekana, visivyo sahihi au visivyoauniwa vinabaki bila kujulikana. Sifuri huonyeshwa pale tu chanzo kinapotoa sifuri.

sw.english: Source QC flags are retained without treating them as independent field verification.
sw.translation: Alama za QC za chanzo zimehifadhiwa bila kuzichukulia kama uthibitisho huru wa shambani.
